The example secrets.yml has no `development:` or `test:` block, only staging and production. So in development, Rails.application.secrets is empty → `secrets.dt` returns nil → error in cors.rb. This is a genuine bug in the repo's config — the shipped secrets.yml.example lacks a development section. In the upstream consul, development section exists. 

Wait but the guide says this exact setup works. Maybe the app works because `config/secrets.yml.example` in an older consul had a development block. But this repo variant (mitmachportal) removed it? Let me check git history of secrets.yml.example.

Actually the git repo only has 1 commit. So we can't see history. The guide says just `cp config/secrets.yml.example config/secrets.yml`. But it fails. So I need to add a development section to secrets.yml with dt settings etc.

This is a recoverable configuration issue. Let me add a development and test block in secrets.yml. Upstream consul's secrets.yml.example has a development block. Let me construct one that satisfies dt, ai, etc.

The `dt: &dt` anchor defines `dt: {domain, enabled, port}`. So `<<: *dt` merges. For development I need `<<: *dt`, `<<: *ai`, `<<: *maps`, `<<: *apis`, `<<: *mapbox`, `<<: *masterportal`? cors uses Dt.url which needs secrets.dt[:domain] and in development secrets.dt[:port].

Also `lib/custom_features.rb` uses `Rails.application.secrets.dig(feature_name, :enabled)`. feature flags: ai maybe.

Let me look at upstream consul's development secrets block. Actually the fetched master example has development block but no dt/ai. In older versions there was dt. This mitmachportal variant's example has dt at top-level anchors but only uses them in staging/production. That seems like an oversight. Let me just add development and test blocks that merge all anchors.
